en.joke: My AI assistant just told me to subscribe to a premium AI assistant to manage my subscriptions.
en.explanation: Funny because it's an absurd, recursive loop reflecting our reliance on tech to manage tech-induced problems.

people.name: Fred Stone
people.extract: Fred Andrew Stone was an American actor. Stone began his career as a performer in circuses and minstrel shows, went on to act in vaudeville, and became a star on Broadway and in feature films, which earned him a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
highlights: Star on Broadway and in feature films.
Earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

people.name: Dennis Eichhorn
people.extract: Dennis P. Eichhorn was an American writer, best known for his adult-oriented autobiographical comic book series Real Stuff. His stories, often involving sex, drugs, and alcohol, have been compared to those of Jack Kerouac, Ken Kesey, and Charles Bukowski.
highlights: Best known for Real Stuff comic book series.
Stories compared to Kerouac, Kesey, Bukowski.

people.name: C. I. Scofield
people.extract: Cyrus Ingerson Scofield was an American theologian, minister, and writer whose best-selling annotated Bible popularized futurism and dispensationalism among fundamentalist Christians.
